MSI had another major vulnerability, following our previous coverage of their accidental exposure of over 600,000 warranty records to the public internet. This time, the MSI vulnerability was in MSI Center, the software responsible for controlling RGB colors and patterns, alongside some power configuration settings. At the time of publishing this, MSI has already patched the issue.

Mr. Bruh's blog post here: https://mrbruh.com/msicenter/
